typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CCYAMT as integer,
		CCYTERMS as string,
		CTRCCY as string,
		PORT as string,
		DEALSRC as string,
		CCYNPVAMT as integer,
		TRAD as string,
		CUST as string,
		DEALDATE as date,
		SWAPDEAL as string,
		BR as string,
		CCYSACCT as string,
		MapKey as string,
		FARNEARIND as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		CCY as string,
		CCYRATE_8 as integer,
		DEALNO as string,
		SPOTFWDIND as string,
		Geo_region as string,
		CTRAMT as integer,
		CMNE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CCYAMT as integer,
		CCYTERMS as string,
		CTRCCY as string,
		PORT as string,
		DEALSRC as string,
		CCYNPVAMT as integer,
		TRAD as string,
		CUST as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		SWAPDEAL as string,
		BR as string,
		CCYSACCT as string,
		MapKey as string,
		FARNEARIND as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		CCY as string,
		CCYRATE_8 as integer,
		DEALNO as string,
		SPOTFWDIND as string,
		Geo_region as string,
		CTRAMT as integer,
		CMNE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PRODTYPE,
		CCYAMT,
		CCYTERMS,
		CTRCCY,
		PORT,
		DEALSRC,
		CCYNPVAMT,
		TRAD,
		CUST,
		DEALDATE,
		SWAPDEAL,
		BR,
		CCYSACCT,
		MapKey,
		FARNEARIND,
		PRODUCT,
		CCY,
		CCYRATE_8,
		DEALNO,
		SPOTFWDIND,
		Geo_region,
		CTRAMT,
		CMNE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
